statement: NVIDIA's Space-1 Vera Rubin module is claimed to deliver up to 25 times the AI processing performance of an H100 GPU, with commercial shipments expected later in 2026.
why: A large stated per-module performance step changes the compute delivered per unit shipped, which bears on how much work a buyer gets per dollar and per watt of installed hardware.

impact.mechanism: A far higher performance-per-module raises effective compute per unit shipped, supporting vendor pricing power while lowering the hardware count needed per unit of AI work.

evidence.excerpt: up to 25 times the AI processing performance of an H100 GPU

confidence.basis: Vendor performance claim relayed by a single secondary outlet; no independent benchmark or filing evidence, and the document notes power figures are unconfirmed.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend falling -> rising); sources: Interesting Engineering, TrendForce
